description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPSyncService class within the OrangeHRM project. The class handles synchronization between LDAP server users and the local system by fetching LDAP entries, creating or updating system users, filtering auth providers, and maintaining consistency by removing local users no longer present on LDAP. It includes methods for LDAP querying, user creation, employee data management, transaction handling, and logging, and uses multiple traits to modularize functionality.

classes.name: LDAPSyncService
classes.description: Service class responsible for synchronizing LDAP users with the system users, including fetching LDAP entries, creating/updating users, handling transactions, and logging.

methods.name: getLDAPDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of LDAPDao, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Initializes and returns LDAPService with proper binding based on LDAP settings.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Fetches LDAP configuration settings or throws an exception if not configured.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers associated with multiple users.

methods.name: fetchAllLDAPUsers
methods.description: Fetches all LDAP users from the LDAP server collections.

methods.name: getHashOfLDAPUser
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash for an LDAPUser object for change detection.

methods.name: createSystemUsers
methods.description: Creates or updates system users based on LDAP user data.

methods.name: trySaveEmployee
methods.description: Attempts to save employee data within a transaction context, handles exceptions.

methods.name: warnMultiUserEmployee
methods.description: Logs a warning if an employee is associated with multiple users.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists employee data after validating email and employee ID uniqueness, throws exceptions on validation failure.

methods.name: filterLDAPAuthProvider
methods.description: Filters auth providers to find LDAP type.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Main method orchestrating the LDAP synchronization process with transaction handling.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollections
methods.description: Fetches LDAP entry collections based on settings.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollection
methods.description: Fetches LDAP entry collection for a specific lookup setting, with caching.

methods.name: prepareLDAPUserFromEntry
methods.description: Constructs an LDAPUser object from an LDAP Entry, with error handling.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value from an LDAP entry.

methods.name: getSearchAttributes
methods.description: Determines LDAP search attributes based on settings.

methods.name: deleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Removes local users who are no longer present in LDAP after collection fetching.
